newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilgener, Canada's Cordex in deal.
newsitem.headline: Chilgener, Canada's Cordex in deal.

text.p: Chile's second largest power generating company Chilgener said it has set up a joint venture with Canada's Cordex Petroleums Inc to build an oil and asphalt terminal at a port in central Chile.
The companies signed a shareholders agreement Monday to build the terminal which will involve an investment of $33.5 million, said Chilgener's general manager Juan Antonio Guzman.
The terminal at the port of Ventanas will be 88 percent owned by Chilgener with the rest held by Cordex, he said.
Ventanas, which lies on the Pacific coast north of Santiago, is owned by Chilgener.

Building work at the terminal will begin immediately and the project should be completed by the second half of 1998, Guzman told a news conference. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
